items.title_en: Thank You! To everyone who has read or listened to my recently released book Protocols
items.title_cn: Thank You! To everyone who has read or listened to my recently released book Protocols
items.desc_en:
I’m honored and humbled that Protocols is a #1NYT Best Seller, an Amazon Book Pick for 2026…

… and most of all with the feedback that people are benefiting from the protocols and science it contains.

Protocols covers the science and protocols for improving your sleep, exercise, stress control, nutrition, using light and its effects on hormones, there’s a comprehensive chapter on focus, motivation, and learning/neuroplasticity, and chapter on personal development that covers how to navigate grief, balancing goal pursuit with the rest of life, task switching & more.

items.title_cn: Happiness Isn't the World's Job | Eckhart Tolle
items.desc_en:
Eckhart Tolle is a world-revered spiritual teacher and author known for sharing practical tools that allow people to experience life more richly.

During the podcast we discuss, and Eckhart demonstrates, how you can access greater inner peace, authenticity, creativity, and connection in your everyday life.

Eckhart also shares tools for quieting compulsive thinking, accessing inner stillness, and adopting a helpful mental vantage point when life gets challenging.

items.title_en: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.title_cn: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.desc_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, I explain how nicotine affects the brain and body, including how it increases dopamine, acetylcholine and norepinephrine to boost motivation, focus and alertness, suppresses appetite and raises heart rate and blood pressure. I distinguish nicotine itself from its delivery methods — smoking, vaping, dipping and snuffing — and explain their serious health risks, why vaping is especially habit-forming and why quitting is so difficult. I also discuss science-based tools to quit smoking or vaping, including clinical hypnosis, prescription medication and nico
